jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Connections (Developer Platform)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

As a Developer Platform engineer, you will directly contribute to the foundational pieces that make Notion extensible and connected. You will build tools, APIs, and platform experiences that help customers connect Notion to the world — bringing their apps, data, and workflows into one workspace. Your work will make it easier for developers, admins, and builders to create reliable integrations and automations on top of Notion.

You will be a key player in building the robust technical foundation that allows Notion to achieve the connected workspace vision. Your work will include both internal platform contributions that accelerate other Notion engineering teams and end-user-facing functionality that enables toolmaking ubiquity. You will be presented with challenging technical problems, as Notion’s product needs are complex. You’ll play a key role in identifying and executing against technical investments that ensure the long-term quality, reliability, and performance of Notion’s platform as we scale.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • You’ll work with a team of engineers and cross-functional partners across product, design, data science, and user research to define a product strategy and drive execution through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance.

  • You’ll evolve Developer Platform capabilities across APIs, MCP tools, and integration infrastructure that help customers automate workflows, customize Notion, and connect Notion to the tools and data they use every day.

  • You’ll contribute to the overall performance, reliability, and robustness of the Notion product, ensuring it scales elegantly across many dimensions.

  • You’ll partner with engineering leaders to identify and execute against high-leverage technical investments that ensure the long-term flexibility and sustainability of our core systems.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 10+ years of experience shipping production software, with a strong track record of owning features end-to-end

  • Fluency with TypeScript across both backend and frontend

  • Strong product instincts: you can take a vague problem, propose a solid technical approach, and know when to cut scope

  • You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience building developer tools like APIs and SDKs

  • Experience driving teams toward shared goals and balancing business priorities with individuals’ strengths, areas of interest, and career development goals

  • Familiarity with AI/agent tooling, evals, or LLM-driven product experiences

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $272,000 – $304,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy and NYLL 144.

#LI-Onsite

A Note on AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

About The Role

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.

 

What You'll Achieve

  • Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

  • Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

  • Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

  • Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

  • Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

  • Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions condsultants up for high-quality first conversations

  • Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

  • High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

  • You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

  • Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

  • Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets


Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For this role, based in New York City, the estimated hourly rate is $33.65 - $38.70 per hour with a 30k annual commission target, annualized to salary range of $100,000 - $115,000 per year.

About The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer on Notion’s Services team, you will lead the hands on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. You will design, build, and deploy production ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business.

You’ll embed with enterprise customers to design and build solutions that integrate Notion deeply into their technical and operational environments. This includes writing and maintaining custom code, designing and deploying production-grade custom agents and AI workflows with MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, building data pipelines and resolving complex challenges around scale, permissions, and governance.

You’ll embed with enterprise customers to design and build solutions that integrate Notion deeply into their technical and operational environments.

This is a customer-facing engineering role for someone who is comfortable writing code, debugging technical issues, explaining tradeoffs to stakeholders, and turning ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. Your work will help shape best practices for how we support complex customer needs and ensure Notion’s platform is ready for scale.

What You'll Achieve

  • Own the hands-on technical delivery of customer engagements, including deep technical discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, and end to end implementation.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers make informed architectural decisions and identify opportunities to expand and deepen their use of Notion.

  • Design, build, and operate custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows.

  • Lead the design and execution of large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, and post-migration optimization.

  • Work directly with customer engineering, IT, security and business stakeholders to gather technical requirements, identify constraints, evaluate feasibility, and make sound architectural decisions that maximizes the value of Notion within their broader technical ecosystem.

  • Troubleshoot complex implementation issues across APIs, integrations, automation logic, data quality, permissions, authentication, system limits, and customer specific environments.

  • Design and operate feedback loops with Product, CX, and Engineering, translating real-world implementation challenges into actionable insights, technical requirements, and tooling improvements that directly influence Notion’s Product Roadmap and our Customers.

  • Build reusable technical assets, including migration tooling, integration patterns, reference implementations, discovery frameworks, technical standards, scripts, and internal delivery tooling.

  • Help define how Services delivers complex technical implementations at scale by improving methodologies, scoping artifacts, build patterns, technical documentation and engineering best practices.

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing or forward deployed engineering role or a similar hands-on technical role.

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python and comfort with writing production-quality code in customer-facing or internal engineering contexts.

  • Hands-on experience with APIs and data integration.

  • Ability to lead technical discovery with customers, assess feasibility, identify risks, scope technical work, estimate effort, and translate ambiguous requirements into an executable plan.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations and customer specific configuration.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences effectively.

  • A track record of delivering customer value by translating technical challenges into solutions that drive outcomes for customers at scale.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working in professional services, preferably in a startup or high-growth environment.

  • Experience deploying AI agents autonomously in complex coding or business workflows.

  • Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows, including work with MCPs, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval/RAG systems or workflow orchestration.

  • Background in developing technical frameworks, discovery methodologies, or internal tooling from the ground up.

  • Experience with ETL/ELT workflows, data transformation, schema mapping, validation scripts, or large-scale content migration tooling.

  • Strong history of collaboration with product and engineering teams, including influencing roadmaps or architectural decisions.

  • Experience supporting pre-sales or early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, and building prototypes or custom scripts to validate approaches.

  • Strong track record of successful enterprise customer implementations.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is $175,000 - $240,000 per year.

About Us:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

About The Role:

Notion is looking for a Sales Development Manager in New York, NY or San Francisco, CA that will recruit, develop, & lead a highly driven and hardworking team of Sales Development Representatives (Inbound) & Business Development Representatives (Outbound). We are looking for someone who is passionate about building a winning team and coaching & elevating the craft of new sellers at Notion. The Sales Development team is the first interaction with prospective Notion customers and is key to the success of our Sales organization!

At Notion the Sales Development team is responsible for driving new business opportunities and expanding market share through qualified pipeline, as well as driving the business forward by developing the next generation of top closers. As the Sales Development Lead you will be responsible for delivering both revenue and talent for our business. You will focus on the Recruitment, Enablement and Execution of your team to assure the continued successful trajectory of this strategically important department.

Our ideal candidate for this role has proven experience in managing, building and encouraging a team to achieve daily, weekly and monthly/quarterly targets in addition to delivering feedback to marketing and sales operations about lead quality and process improvements.

What You'll Achieve:

  1. As an AMER Sales Development Manager, you will work directly with Sales Managers, cross functionally with Marketing Leadership, & Revenue Operations Leadership in creating and developing Notion’s Sales Development strategy, process and playbooks

  2. Partnering with regional leaders across Sales Strategy, Marketing, and Sales teams to plan territory mapping and pipeline development programs

  3. Build winning teams through Attracting, Hiring, and Developing the world’s best xDRs

  4. Enable your team to relentlessly prospect, identify and qualify sales pipeline through your coaching and mentoring on topics including courageous qualification, prospecting techniques, phone skills, and strategic engagement with Account Executives

  5. Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to ensure we capitalize on the massive market opportunity ahead of us

  6. Help build the foundations of Sales at Notion: As an early member of our sales org, you'll be instrumental in helping define our sales assisted motions.

  7. Join a fantastic team at a magical time: We've hit profitability and over 100 million users with a small team, which gives us a huge green field to work with. You'll join at the perfect time to shape how we grow from here.

  8. Meaningfully shape our future product: As you engage with customers, you'll gain insights to help us serve them better — and work with the product to inform what we do next.

  9. Elevate your skills as we tackle our most impactful challenges: We've achieved more than teams 10x our size in less time — and there's so much more to do and learn.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Experience including either

    • 1-2 years managing a high-performing Sales Development team

    • 1-2 years Account Executive experience (and strong performance) at a SaaS company; after having successfully made the leap from Sales Development to Account Executive

  • Strong track record of achieving sales targets across team and individual goals

  • Skilled in managing and coaching early-career salespeople

  • You have strong, recognized leadership skills with a focus on empowerment, positive mindsets, collaboration, and the ability to inspire a team of direct reports

  • You are comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of iteration of a high growth startup

  • You have a growth mindset and thrive in the building stage of an early stage team

  • You view setbacks as learning opportunities, not failures

  • You have a high EQ and exceptional interpersonal skills, the ability to manage influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building

  • You have an analytical mindset and enjoy problem-solving as part of a regional leadership team

  • You have strong empathy for customers and a passion for revenue and growth

  • You have a good understanding of value selling

  • You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results

Nice to Haves:

  • You've built new business sales playbooks or processes

  • You've been a first or early hire at a fast-growing start-up before

  • Experience leading and improving Sales Development critical metrics

  • Experience running successful weekly and monthly team meetings

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Notion.

Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.

 

What You’ll Achieve

  • Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

  • Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

  • Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

  • Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

  • Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

  • Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

  • Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

  • Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

  • Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.

     

Skills You’ll Need to Bring

  • Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

  • Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

  • Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

  • Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

  • Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

  • Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

  • Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

  • Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

  • Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

  • Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

  • You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

  • You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.

     

Nice to Haves

  • Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

  • Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

  • Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

  • Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

  • Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

  • Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €123,000-€138,000 per year.

  • Use talent-market research, mapping, and recruiting data to improve hiring strategy and decision quality.

  • Raise the quality and consistency of the hiring system through structured intake, calibration, debriefs, manager coaching, and sourcing strategies that expand representation.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

  • Define and evolve the roadmap for Notion’s core mobile AI surfaces, including chat, capture, agent workflows, workspace Q&A, and lightweight creation flows.

  • Improve the production quality of mobile AI by identifying instrumentation gaps, reliability risks, and performance bottlenecks before they become user problems.

  • Help the team build the right technical foundations for fast iteration across mobile, web, and server boundaries.

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • Engineering leadership: You have 2+ years managing engineering teams and have helped teams ship high-quality products at scale.

  • Hands-on technical leadership: You stay close enough to the code to guide architecture, performance, reliability, and release-quality decisions — and can make small contributions when it helps the team move faster.

  • AI product curiosity: You don’t need to be an AI researcher, but you are hands-on with AI tools and curious about how AI changes product development, engineering workflows, and user expectations.

  • Execution through ambiguity: You can turn open-ended product bets into clear strategy, sequencing, staffing, and delivery.

  • Cross-functional leadership: You work well with across different functions to define problems and ship polished outcomes.

  • People leadership: You recruit, coach, and grow engineers, build an inclusive team, and communicate clearly through disagreement.

Nice to Haves

  • You’ve led teams building AI product experiences involving streaming UX, tool use, voice or multimodal input, evaluation loops, or reliability guardrails.

  • You’ve managed teams through 0→1 product development or fast iteration on new product surfaces.

  • You have experience with mobile platform concerns such as offline resilience, realtime collaboration, rich-text editing, app performance, or release quality at scale.

  • You’ve led teams delivering end-to-end product experiences across mobile, web, and server boundaries.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

  • Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

  • Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

  • Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

  • Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

  • Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

  • Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

  • Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

  • Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

  • Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

  • You don't need to be an AI expert, but you have a strong interest in the evolving AI landscape, stay closely attuned to industry trends and developments, and are curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

  • Native or bilingual level fluency Japanese and business-level English proficiency across speaking, listening, and reading, including the ability to support team members with global communication

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the GTM strategy, operating rhythm, and growth plan for Germany, with accountability for overall regional revenue outcomes across Sales Assist and Self Serve contribution.

  • Lead as a second-line manager: hire, coach, and develop frontline leaders and IC teams across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, and supporting GTM functions.

  • Scale a country-first GTM motion that brings Notion closer to German customers through local executive engagement, market nuance, and faster field-level decision-making.

  • Accelerate the land engine by opening the right front doors, growing professional workspaces, increasing net-new and upgrade opportunities, and connecting self-serve signals to sales-assisted motion.

  • Win lighthouse customers and turn them into market momentum by making them wildly successful, telling their story locally, and using those wins to influence peer companies across Germany.

  • Embed Notion’s AI-era GTM model across the team, including agent-enabled customer journeys, first-agent workflow activation, AI/agent demo proficiency, and stronger “build with the customer” motions.

  • Make agentic transformation central to the German GTM motion: help customers identify high-value workflows, build and deploy Notion Agents, automate cross-functional work, and measure outcomes from AI adoption.

  • Partner tightly with Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers, Professional Services, and Channel to reduce handoffs and deliver faster, more durable customer value.

  • Build “sell with” partner motions in Germany, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-sell plays, enablement, AI/agentic solution packages, and joint account planning.

  • Establish Notion as a visible force in the German ecosystem through executive dinners, field events, startup and community engagement, partner activations, and customer advocacy.

  • Represent the voice of German customers back to Product, PMM, Marketing, and EMEA leadership, especially around AI transformation, enterprise requirements, security, compliance, localization, and competitive dynamics.

  • Create a talent destination in Germany by hiring builder-oriented leaders and ICs, raising the craft bar, and developing the next generation of AI-native GTM talent.

  • Drive operational excellence across forecasting, pipeline quality, territory planning, inspection cadence, performance management, and cross-functional execution.

Who We're Looking For:

A strategic and hands-on GTM operator who has scaled enterprise SaaS or AI businesses in Germany and knows how to build a market, not just inherit one. You have led through managers, owned complex revenue outcomes, and created local market momentum through customers, partners, community, and talent.

You combine second-line leadership with builder energy. You can set a crisp country strategy, install the operating system to execute it, and step into the field when needed — whether joining an executive customer conversation, sharpening a pipeline plan, coaching a manager, or helping the team translate a customer problem into an AI-powered, agentic workflow.

You are excited by Notion’s shift to an AI-native, country-first GTM model and believe the best GTM teams will increasingly be builders: BDRs who identify transformation opportunities, Solutions Consultants who build with customers in the room, Outcomes Architects who turn early workflows into durable adoption, and Forward Deployed Architects/Engineers who design the technical systems behind complex agentic workflows.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 12+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years SaaS or AI sales & GTM teams in Germany.

  • Proven second-line leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing frontline managers and high-performing IC teams.

  • Track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets across new business, expansion, and renewal/churn dynamics.

  • Deep knowledge of the German enterprise and startup ecosystem, including executive buyer networks, local partner channels, and market-specific buying dynamics.

  • Experience building or scaling a regional/country business in a high-growth or ambiguous environment.

  • Experience selling, implementing, or leading GTM teams around AI, automation, agentic workflows, collaboration, productivity, developer, or data products.

  • Strong strategic judgment: ability to define a country plan, segment the market, prioritize accounts and plays, and align cross-functional teams around outcomes.

  • Operational rigor across forecasting, pipeline generation, inspection, performance management, territory planning, and sales process.

  • Executive presence with CIO, CTO, CPO, COO, and business transformation buyers, with the ability to shape a compelling AI and agentic workflow narrative.

  • Strong understanding of modern GTM motions across Business Development, Solutions Consulting, Outcomes Architecture, Forward Deployed Architecture/Engineering, Professional Services, Channel, Marketing, RevOps, and Product.

  • Builder mentality and deep AI curiosity: comfortable learning, demoing, and coaching teams on agent-first workflows, proof-of-value motions, and customer co-building.

  • Fluency in German and English.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience launching or scaling a country-first or regional GTM operating model.

  • Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, APIs, webhooks, connectors, data residency, AI governance, and technical evaluation processes.

  • Experience scaling partner, channel, marketplace, or consultant-led GTM motions around AI or workflow transformation.

About The Role

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work, and protecting that trust is foundational to everything we build.

We’re looking for a hands-on Detection Engineer to build and operate the systems and workflows we use to detect and respond to attacks across Notion’s cloud-native environment. You’ll ship high-signal detections, improve the platform that powers them, participate in incident response, and help shape how detection and response engineering scales at Notion.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Corporate Security, and Infrastructure, with broad latitude to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and build what’s needed next.

We view detection and response as a software engineering discipline: detections are code, platforms are products, and measurement matters

What You'll Achieve

  • Build and tune high-signal detections across cloud, identity, endpoint, and SaaS environments, with review and mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp up.

  • Contribute to the detection platform, including rule lifecycle management, tuning, measurement, and rollout safety.

  • Build tooling and automation that speed up triage, enrichment, investigation, and detection authoring, including LLM-based workflows where useful.

  • Turn threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into detections, telemetry requirements, and response improvements.

  • Take part in investigations, incident response, and postmortems, and help turn what we learn into lasting fixes.

  • Help define and track metrics such as coverage, MTTD, and alert quality.

  • Join a shared on-call rotation for incident response.

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • We're hiring across a range of experience levels. If you have some of these skills but not all, we'd still like to hear from you.

    • 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role.

    • Have written or tuned detections that run in production, and care about signal quality and cutting noise.

    • Working knowledge of at least one detection or query language (Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA-L, EQL, or Panther), or strong SQL or Python skills and the drive to learn one quickly.

    • An understanding of how attackers operate (for example, MITRE ATT&CK), and the ability to use it to decide what to detect.

    • Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, ideally including identity and access logs.

    • Have used SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools in any size of environment.

    • Write clearly in runbooks, design docs, and incident notes, and can own well-scoped projects end to end.

Nice to Have

  • Have led purple team, blue team, or adversary emulation exercises that improved detections or telemetry.

  • Experience running SIEM, EDR, or SOAR platforms at large scale.

  • Experience building or maintaining detection-as-code workflows (version control, CI, and tests for detections).

  • Experience applying LLMs or agent-style tooling to security workflows.

  • Experience securing AI-enabled systems or endpoint tooling.

  • Kubernetes or container detection experience.

  • Background in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or digital forensics.

  • Contributions to the security community through research, tooling, CTFs, or talks.

  • Experience at a high-growth startup or AI company.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below.    - 3+ years of experience in detection engineering, security operations, incident response, threat hunting, or a closely related security or software engineering role.
   
   - Have written or tuned detections that run in production, and care about signal quality and cutting noise.
   
   - Working knowledge of at least one detection or query language (Sigma, KQL, SPL, YARA-L, EQL, or Panther), or strong SQL or Python skills and the drive to learn one quickly.
   
   - An understanding of how attackers operate (for example, MITRE ATT&CK), and the ability to use it to decide what to detect.
   
   - Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, ideally including identity and access logs.
   
   - Have used SIEM, EDR, or SOAR tools in any size of environment.
   
   - Write clearly in runbooks, design docs, and incident notes, and can own well-scoped projects end to end.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Have led purple team, blue team, or adversary emulation exercises that improved detections or telemetry.

 - Experience running SIEM, EDR, or SOAR platforms at large scale.

 - Experience building or maintaining detection-as-code workflows (version control, CI, and tests for detections).

 - Experience applying LLMs or agent-style tooling to security workflows.

 - Experience securing AI-enabled systems or endpoint tooling.

 - Kubernetes or container detection experience.

 - Background in threat intelligence, malware analysis, or digital forensics.

 - Contributions to the security community through research, tooling, CTFs, or talks.

 - Experience at a high-growth startup or AI company.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer on Notion’s Services team, you will lead the hands on technical delivery of our most complex customer engagements. You will design, build, and deploy production ready solutions that help enterprise customers integrate Notion as the operating layer for their business.

 

You’ll embed with enterprise customers to design and build solutions that integrate Notion deeply into their technical and operational environments. This includes writing and maintaining custom code, designing and deploying production-grade custom agents and AI workflows with MCP, Agent APIs, and Notion’s automation and execution infrastructure, building data pipelines and resolving complex challenges around scale, permissions, and governance.

 

You’ll embed with enterprise customers to design and build solutions that integrate Notion deeply into their technical and operational environments.

 

This is a customer-facing engineering role for someone who is comfortable writing code, debugging technical issues, explaining tradeoffs to stakeholders, and turning ambiguous customer problems into scalable technical solutions. Your work will help shape best practices for how we support complex customer needs and ensure Notion’s platform is ready for scale.

 

This role is based in Tokyo, Japan. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We're looking for someone who's excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 

What You'll Achieve

  • Own the hands-on technical delivery of customer engagements, including deep technical discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, and end to end implementation.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers make informed architectural decisions and identify opportunities to expand and deepen their use of Notion.

  • Design, build, and operate custom agents, integrations, automations, and data pipelines that connect Notion with customers’ systems and workflows.

  • Lead the design and execution of large-scale content and data migrations, including discovery, scoping, data modeling, transformation logic, validation, and post-migration optimization.

  • Work directly with customer engineering, IT, security and business stakeholders to gather technical requirements, identify constraints, evaluate feasibility, and make sound architectural decisions that maximizes the value of Notion within their broader technical ecosystem.

  • Troubleshoot complex implementation issues across APIs, integrations, automation logic, data quality, permissions, authentication, system limits, and customer specific environments.

  • Design and operate feedback loops with Product, CX, and Engineering, translating real-world implementation challenges into actionable insights, technical requirements, and tooling improvements that directly influence Notion’s Product Roadmap and our Customers.

  • Build reusable technical assets, including migration tooling, integration patterns, reference implementations, discovery frameworks, technical standards, scripts, and internal delivery tooling.

  • Help define how Services delivers complex technical implementations at scale by improving methodologies, scoping artifacts, build patterns, technical documentation and engineering best practices.

 

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing or forward deployed engineering role or a similar hands-on technical role.

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Java, JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, or Python and comfort with writing production-quality code in customer-facing or internal engineering contexts.

  • Hands-on experience with APIs and data integration.

  • Ability to lead technical discovery with customers, assess feasibility, identify risks, scope technical work, estimate effort, and translate ambiguous requirements into an executable plan.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to isolate root causes across code, APIs, permissions, integrations and customer specific configuration.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences effectively.

  • A track record of delivering customer value by translating technical challenges into solutions that drive outcomes for customers at scale.

 

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working in professional services, preferably in a startup or high-growth environment.

  • Experience deploying AI agents autonomously in complex coding or business workflows.

  • Experience designing or implementing AI-powered workflows, including work with MCPs, APIs, LLM applications, prompt engineering, retrieval/RAG systems or workflow orchestration.

  • Background in developing technical frameworks, discovery methodologies, or internal tooling from the ground up.

  • Experience with ETL/ELT workflows, data transformation, schema mapping, validation scripts, or large-scale content migration tooling.

  • Strong history of collaboration with product and engineering teams, including influencing roadmaps or architectural decisions.

  • Experience supporting pre-sales or early engagement phases, including technical discovery, migration scoping, feasibility analysis, effort estimation, and building prototypes or custom scripts to validate approaches.

  • Strong track record of successful enterprise customer implementations.

About the Role

As a Product Operations Manager, you’ll work closely with Product and Engineering teams to drive launch operations and quality, ensuring teams can operate effectively as Notion scales. You’ll serve as the core liaison between Product and the go-to-market organization, helping ensure new products and features are successful.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

The ideal candidate is able to dive into ambiguous problems that require deep technical fluency, think in systems to scale technical programs, identify and build agentic workflows to accelerate processes, and communicate effectively to drive alignment across cross-functional teams. Your core responsibilities are:

  • Partner with product teams to help drive product strategy by synthesizing customer + internal signals into clear insights, framing bets/tradeoffs, and driving alignment on priorities.

  • Build agentic workflows, tooling and processes that drive engineering velocity and a higher bar for launch quality

  • Coordinate end-to-end launch of new features across teams, starting with early access programs with external customers to setting clear exit criteria for GA launches, to ensure successful outcomes.

  • Build evergreen feedback loops and triage + evaluation systems that allow teams build with confidence and prioritize the right bets.

  • Build strong relationships and drive clarity with key partner teams.

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • You have at least 4+ years of experience working in product operations, technical program management, project management, or a product ownership role.

  • You regularly work and keep up with AI tools (i.e Claude Skills, Cowork, Codex etc) to support your work.

  • You can identify tradeoffs between building systems or processes that don’t scale to ensure successful outcomes.

  • You have strong communication skills and can work with both technical and non-technical audiences. This includes teams like Research, Data Science, Product, Security, Legal, Support, and Customer Success

  • You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills that allow you to act with high agency, at multiple altitudes.

  • You know when to prioritize collecting more information and when to make decisions with limited data.

  • You can operate in a fast paced environment where priorities and challenges can change quickly.

Nice To Haves

  • Strong knowledge of basic scripting, APIs, MySQL, MCPs and similar open source technologies.

  • Knowledge of and experience using one or more of the following languages - Python, Go, C++ or Java and are comfortable with Github, CLI, etc.

  • Background in product management or engineering.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco and New York, the estimated base salary range for this role is $170,000-$210,000 per year.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. About The Role

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.

 

What You'll Achieve

  • Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

  • Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

  • Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

  • Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

  • Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • Fluency in Korean and business level in English

  • Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

  • Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

  • Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

  • High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

  • You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

You’ll be the technical face of Notion Academy: leading workshops, recording walkthroughs, and building implementation guides.

 

This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Expand Notion’s technical education library. Author technically rigorous Academy content, implementation guides, and Help Center resources that make our most complex capabilities easier to understand and adopt.

  • Become a trusted voice for Notion Academy. Teach customers through video, live webinars, and workshops, demonstrating real workflows and solving problems in real time.

  • Build with Notion’s newest capabilities. Get hands-on with new product features, use customer insights to identify high-value use cases, and determine top priority workflows for education to focus on.

  • Reimagine learning with AI. Experiment with adaptive, contextual learning experiences that respond to what customers are trying to build and where they need help.

  • Prove and scale the impact of technical education. Use product adoption signals to measure impact and improve what we teach, then build reusable standards to help the team deliver effective technical learning faster.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Builder mindset: You learn new product features by getting hands-on, experimenting, and building until you understand.

  • Comfort navigating technical content: you don’t need to write code, but you can read a technical architecture doc, identify what’s outdated, and work with engineers to fix it.

  • Customer-facing credibility: You’re comfortable teaching, building, and troubleshooting in front of customers.

  • AI experimentation: You actively use AI to build, learn, and teach technical proficiency.

  • Product expertise: You can quickly understand a new feature, identify where it creates meaningful customer value, and turn that into practical use cases.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, developer relations, or technical enablement

As Business Development Manager, you'll be the ecosystem partner to our engineering and product teams, launching and deepening integrations with frontier intelligence platforms and the tools our customers already use. You'll be the voice of partners within Notion, shaping our product roadmap and driving adoption of new APIs and developer tools in the ecosystem. You'll also get to design and execute growth strategies that drive new user demand and own relationships with some of our strategic partners like OpenAI, Anthropic, Slack, and Google.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

  • Scale the Notion platform: In close collaboration with partners and Notion’s product and engineering teams, identify, evaluate and facilitate launch of new product integrations. Project manage partner-centric launches - from partner onboarding and implementation, to driving go-to-market and post-launch tracking.

  • Drive partner strategy: Own and grow relationships with select strategic partners, becoming their voice within Notion. Identify, evaluate and implement new product and co-marketing opportunities that create outsized value for partners, Notion and our shared customers.

  • Be the best partner to the best partners: As an internal advocate for Notion’s partners, ensure their needs are being considered and reflected in our roadmap and planning. Provide ongoing support to grow our strategic relationships.

  • Accelerate distribution partnerships: Source, evaluate, and launch first-in-kind partnerships that drive new user demand for Notion. From negotiation to launch and performance tracking, turn successful deals into scalable programs based on adoption and revenue signals.

 
 

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • 7+ years in business development / strategic partnerships / product / growth

  • Strong product instincts and experience working closely with engineering, product and go-to-market teams

  • High agency and comfort operating in ambiguity. You can drive clarity where a playbook doesn’t exist yet

  • Operational rigor, ability to execute end-to-end and manage complex cross-functional projects

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills. You can tell a clear and compelling story in docs, decks, and in person

 

Nice to Haves:

  • You've been an early go-to-market or product hire at a fast-growing company before

  • You have fluency working with ISVs and across developer ecosystems

  • You’ve built partnerships across multiple regions (AMER, EMEA, APAC)

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. About The Role

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role

What You’ll Achieve

  • Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

  • Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

Collections Experience owns the product experience for Notion’s database block and everything on top of it: properties, views, forms, permissions, and many more features. If you’ve ever typed /database in a Notion page, you’ve already used something our team built.

We’re hiring an experienced software engineer to accelerate our mission to build a flexible, reliable, and intuitive primitive that gives everyone the power to model their work exactly as they imagine— from simple lists to the most complex workflows.

We’re 8+ engineers, designers, and PMs across SF and NYC. You’ll work across the stack in TypeScript, ship features that touch both the data model and the UI, and help shape where the database block goes next.

What You'll Achieve

  • Design and ship new database properties and views that expand what people can model in Notion

  • Design permission models that hold up at the scale of our largest customers

  • Partner with the Agent team to grow what Notion Agent can do with databases, from tool development to eval-driven iteration

  • Collaborate closely with product and design on features that are ambiguous up front and require strong technical judgment to scope

  • Raise the bar on code review, testing, and technical design across the team

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • 10+ years shipping production software, with a strong track record of owning features end-to-end

  • Fluency with TypeScript across both backend and frontend

  • Strong product instincts: you can take a vague problem, propose a solid technical approach, and know when to cut scope

  • Experience on systems where data model decisions have long-lived consequences (databases, permissions, collaborative editing, or similar)

  • You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience building database, spreadsheet, or workflow tools

  • Background in permissions or authorization systems at scale

  • Familiarity with AI/agent tooling, evals, or LLM-driven product experiences

As a enterprise technical support engineer, you will work closely with our enterprise customers and engineers to resolve their most complex issues. You will also help build out systems and processes to manage tasks to completion. You will problem solve with our technical teams and work to resolve as much as you can while scaling our systems and support processes.

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve

  • Work closely with our largest customers providing white-glove support to solve the most challenging support interactions

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with enterprise customers, ensuring high levels of engagement and satisfaction

  • Lead the troubleshooting and resolution of advanced technical issues across Notion’s platform and embedded partner applications, with a focus on unlocking AI usage for customers

  • Act as a bridge between your customers and Notion engineering teams by reproducing issues, driving resolution through detailed bug reports, and closing the loop proactively with your customers

  • Work cross-functionally across engineering and product to build processes and manage issues

  • Perform advanced troubleshooting of products and embedded partner applications

  • Reproduce customer issues, perform initial codebase triage, and file bugs with Engineering

  • Manage key performance metrics defined within the team

  • Respond to high-priority customer issues

  • Create, refine, and scale support processes, working to improve overall support efficiency and effectiveness in handling complex, high-priority cases

  • Collaborate on the creation and maintenance of both internal knowledge and customer-facing documentation, enhancing self-service support options for customers

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to assist customers outside of normal working hours (once in a few months)

Skills You'll Need to Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in technical support, technical account management, or similar role

  • You have experience owning and scaling support processes end-to-end to drive customer and company outcomes. This includes but is not limited to creating internal documentation, proposing and owning process changes, and advocating for specific customer outcomes

  • You have a strong understanding of and experience with REST APIs

  • You have experience advising customers on AI tool adoption

  • You have knowledge of Single Sign-On including OAuth, SAML, and SCIM

  • You have knowledge and experience troubleshooting desktop applications on Microsoft Windows and macOS

  • You have experience advising both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and communicating complex issues with clarity

  • You have strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills

  • You are able to analyze server and client application logs and identify the root cause of errors

  • You have strong written and verbal communication skills and can work with both technical and non-technical audiences

  • You are able to balance user expectations while understanding policies and compliance boundaries

  • You are able to work under pressure and remain focused, confident and professional

  • You are able to collaborate effectively with peers and across teams that are located in multiple offices

  • You have experience mentoring more junior team members to deepen their technical expertise and drive outcomes for the business and customers

  • You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results

Nice to Haves

  • Knowledge of Linux, APIs, NoSQL, MySQL, and similar open-source technologies

  • Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript

  • Deep existing knowledge of Notion

  • Experience operating in an organization that does Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS)

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. About the Role:

Notion is looking for an experienced Lifecycle Marketing Manager, Campaign Strategy & Execution to develop and execute campaigns that help users discover value, adopt key workflows, and deepen their use of Notion.

You'll own campaigns end to end: translating business and customer opportunities into clear strategies, defining audiences and journeys, coordinating creative and technical production, launching across email and in-product channels, and measuring incremental impact.

This role combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution. You'll partner closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product Marketing, Product Growth, Data Science, Marketing Operations, and creative partners. You should be equally comfortable shaping a campaign brief, building a journey in Customer.io, resolving execution details, and interpreting results.

Scope guardrails: this role owns campaign strategy, hands-on execution, cross-functional delivery, and performance analysis. It is not the primary Customer.io architect or incident-response owner, a general intake coordinator, or a production-only role receiving prewritten briefs. The person should operate as an independent campaign owner who can take work from an ambiguous opportunity to a high-quality, measured launch.

This role may be based in either our San Francisco or New York City offices. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Own the campaign portfolio. Independently lead a portfolio of launch, one-off, and evergreen lifecycle campaigns with clear prioritization and predictable delivery.

  • Turn opportunities into strategies. Translate product launches, lifecycle moments, and business priorities into clear objectives, audiences, journeys, channel plans, and success metrics.

  • Build high-impact lifecycle programs. Develop campaigns across onboarding, activation, adoption, collaboration, monetization, retention, and resurrection.

  • Execute from brief to measurement. Own audience creation, build, QA, localization, launch readiness, and post-campaign analysis across email and in-product messaging.

  • Improve foundational journeys. Audit existing programs and recommend which should be maintained, improved, rebuilt, or retired; lead the rebuild of priority onboarding or adoption journeys.

  • Raise the experimentation bar. Develop testable hypotheses and use segmentation, personalization, holdouts, and A/B tests to understand incremental impact.

  • Measure customer and business outcomes. Connect campaigns to activation, product adoption, collaboration, conversion, retention, or qualified sales outcomes—not only opens and clicks.

  • Lead cross-functional delivery. Coordinate dependencies across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales, and external partners.

  • Create repeatable systems. Turn recurring campaign work into templates, playbooks, and reusable operating patterns that improve quality and velocity.

  • Enable safe self-service. Help cross-functional partners execute effectively while maintaining Lifecycle's strategic, customer-experience, and quality standards.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • Significant experience owning lifecycle, CRM, growth, or product-marketing campaigns from strategy through execution.

  • A track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional campaigns at meaningful scale.

  • Strong customer-journey thinking across activation, adoption, engagement, conversion, and retention.

  • Hands-on experience with a lifecycle platform such as Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, or Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

  • Strong audience segmentation, personalization, experimentation, and campaign-measurement skills.

  • Ability to use data to prioritize opportunities, evaluate results, and change strategy; working knowledge of SQL or self-serve analytics is a plus.

  • Excellent project leadership: clear briefs, dependable execution, proactive risk management, and crisp stakeholder communication.

  • Strong editorial and customer judgment—you care about sending useful, relevant messages rather than maximizing message volume.

  • Comfort operating in a product-led, highly cross-functional environment with incomplete information.

  • Experience with B2B or product-led growth, product telemetry, in-product messaging, or AI-assisted campaign workflows is a plus.

  • 8+ total years relevant + transferrable experience.

What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months:

  • Establish a clear operating rhythm for launch, one-off, and evergreen campaigns.

  • Independently own a meaningful portfolio from strategy through performance analysis.

  • Launch a materially improved onboarding, activation, or adoption journey with a defined experiment and measurement plan.

  • Establish consistent briefs, segmentation standards, QA, launch-readiness checks, and post-campaign readouts.

  • Demonstrate credible incremental movement in a product or business outcome.

  • Create meaningful capacity for senior Lifecycle teammates to focus on systems architecture, journey strategy, personalization, and modernization.


Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 – $220,000 per year.
